Atlas.intro: Choose an area and trace its property information back to the original sources.

Map.spatial: Spatial match; ownership and commercial identity are unconfirmed.
Map.imageryNote: Sentinel-2: 10 m per pixel. Annual composites combine multiple dates. Esri acquisition dates vary by tile. At close zoom, available imagery is enlarged without additional detail.
Map.searchPrompt: Name, street, usage or parcel code
Map.resetBearing: Drag to rotate map, click to reset north
Map.exploreHint: Select a project, building or parcel on the map.
Map.nearbyNote: Recorded places within 1.5 km, measured in a straight line from the mapped point or footprint centre. Coverage may be incomplete; opening status and walking routes are not verified.
Map.nearbyEmpty: No recorded amenities within this radius.
Map.overlapAlert: Another cadastral record overlaps this land.
Map.overlapNote: These distinct records have at least 80% mutual footprint overlap. Published uses may differ; neither record proves what is built here. Open each record to compare its source and dates.
Map.proximityMatch: Project association suggested from map proximity (within 50 m); unconfirmed. Distance to the parcel footprint.
Map.imageryCoverage: The selected source applies to the entire map. Missing imagery is never replaced with another source.
Map.imageryUnavailable: Imagery unavailable. Choose another source in View.
Map.catalogue3dNote: Green: recorded height. Sand: estimate (3 m per floor; otherwise 3 m). Volumes do not confirm construction status.
Map.world3dNote: OpenStreetMap volumes: heights may be estimated and coverage varies. No photographic façades.
Map.gesture3d: Tilt and rotate with two fingers on mobile, or right-drag on desktop. Zoom in to see buildings.
Map.threeDUnavailable: 3D context unavailable. Try the platform buildings or return to 2D.
Map.analysisScope: Search and counts cover loaded data only.
Map.drawHint: Click to place points. Enter finishes; Escape exits. Measurements are indicative.
Map.walkOrigin: Click the map to choose a starting point.
Map.walkPending: Preparing the calculation; this may take a few minutes.
Map.walkUnavailable: Walking calculation unavailable. Choose another point or try again.
Map.walkNote: OSM network estimate, without live traffic or timetables. Local access is not guaranteed.
Map.compareNote: Compared imagery is on the left. Annual mosaics do not date individual buildings.
Map.solarShadowNote: Flat-ground convex shadows, only for catalogue buildings with recorded heights. No mutual occlusion or interiors; hidden below 5° sun elevation.
Map.solarNote: Clear-sky scene lighting at the map centre. This does not measure weather, lux or indoor sunlight.
Map.marketMapNote: District aggregates for the selected snapshot and search. Mixed property types; rates require at least 5 values. Boundaries are current archived boundaries, not transaction locations.
Map.marketMissing: sales without an unambiguous mapped district
Map.coastlineNotice: The basemap coastline and cadastral limits come from different sources and may reflect different dates or planned land.

Delivery.title: Delivery history
Delivery.intro: Handover dates each source announced over time, compared with readings of the ADREC project register. A delay is shown only when a register reading proves it, and only as a minimum.
Delivery.limits: Sources have been collected since October 2026. Dates from different sources are never compared with each other, and no delay is estimated.
Delivery.movedLater: Handover pushed back by its source
Delivery.noAnnouncements: No handover date announced in the collected sources.
Delivery.noRegister: No ADREC register record for this project: its delivery cannot be observed.
Delivery.outcomeLate: Still unfinished after the announced date

Sources.title: Sources and licences
Sources.intro: Licence, terms and allowed reuse of every source site, from the reviewed registry. A site not reviewed yet still has terms to qualify.
Sources.publicationFacts: dated facts, a short quote and a link

Retention.title: Retention if the purchase is cancelled
Retention.atDeclaredStage: Developer retention at the stage currently declared
Retention.ofPrice: of the sale contract value, if the purchaser defaults and the unit is cancelled.
Retention.unreadable: The declared progress cannot be read against the schedule.
Retention.declaredProgress: Progress declared in the ADREC register
Retention.boundary: The declared progress sits exactly on a band limit. The cited commentaries do not say which band applies, so both rates are shown.
Retention.fullRefund: Works not started: the purchaser is fully refunded if the delay is due to causes outside the developer's control. The register does not show the cause.
Retention.paidShare: ADREC sets the retention case by case once the purchaser has paid more than this share of the price:
Retention.stageAssessed: The rate applies to the stage ADREC or its consultants assess at cancellation, which may differ from the latest declared progress.
Retention.officialTextMissing: The official text could not be obtained. The schedule is taken from these legal commentaries:
Retention.notAdvice: Reading aid only, not legal advice. Refer to the decision and to ADREC.

Verification.title: Verification
Verification.intro: What the ADREC project register states at its latest reading, and where the cited sources disagree.
Verification.noReading: No ADREC register reading is matched to this project yet: its status, progress and escrow cannot be checked here.
Verification.reportExpired: expired on the date of the reading
Verification.completion: The register first stated completion on
Verification.noContradictions: No disagreement found between the collected announcements and register readings.
Verification.announcedAfterCompletion: Announced after the register stated completion
Verification.announcedAfterCompletionNote: This source still announces a later handover period after the register first stated completion.
Verification.announcedPeriodPassedNote: The announced handover period has ended and a later register reading does not state completion.
Verification.sourcesDisagreeNote: Two sources currently announce handover periods that do not overlap.
Verification.progressDecreasedNote: A later reading of the same register record declares less progress than an earlier one.
Verification.checksLimits: Each point puts cited readings side by side. It names no cause and does not say which source is right.
Verification.noOfficialLink: No official register page has been reviewed for this project yet. Search its registration number on the ADREC register.
Verification.retentionLink: Retention if the purchase is cancelled
Verification.notAdvice: A reading aid, not legal or financial advice. Confirm with ADREC and the developer before paying.

Activity.title: Ground change seen by satellite
Activity.intro: A signal of change on the ground of the project's parcel between two Sentinel-2 images. It is not construction progress and is never given as a percentage.
Activity.noParcel: No satellite measurement for this project yet. A parcel is measured only when a review links it to the project, or when a register point or building footprint of the project falls inside a single parcel of 0.2 to 10 ha; new image pairs are compared each month.
Activity.insufficient: Could not be measured: too few clear pixels (clouds, shadows, or a parcel too small at 10 m per pixel).
Activity.basisReviewedParcel: Linked to the project by a review
Activity.basisAuthorityPoint: Contains the project's point in the authority register
Activity.basisBuildingFootprint: Contains a reviewed building footprint of the project
Activity.derivedNote: This parcel is deduced from the project's position: the signal describes the whole parcel, which may hold more than this project.
Activity.methodText: Each 10 m pixel of the parcel is compared between the two images, keeping only pixels free of cloud, shadow or missing data on both dates. The level depends on the share of pixels whose reflectance changed; its thresholds are not yet calibrated on verified building sites.
Activity.limitResolution: 10 m per pixel: a small parcel has few pixels, and a parcel under 0.2 ha is not measured.
Activity.limitProgress: A change is not progress, and no change is not a halt (interior works, finishing).
Activity.limitConditions: Season, dust, shadows of neighbouring towers and sun angle also change reflectance.
Activity.limitFrequency: At most one image per month; the dates shown are those of the images.

Schedule.title: Payment schedule simulator
Schedule.intro: Enter the price and the payment plan from the developer's offer or contract. Nothing is filled in for you: the platform has no sourced plan or fee for this project.
Schedule.start: Enter the price and at least one payment to see the schedule.
Schedule.enteredByYou: Plan entered by you: check it against the signed contract.
Schedule.readings: Declared progress in the ADREC register
Schedule.noReadings: No dated progress reading in the register: payments tied to progress cannot be placed in time.
Schedule.dueAfter: not yet reached at the reading of
Schedule.notReached: not reached in any reading so far
Schedule.handoverOpen: Handover is not read from a percentage: its date stays open.
Schedule.noReadingAtDate: no reading on or before this date
Schedule.paidShare: Share of the price paid after this payment:
Schedule.barNote: Bar: solid = share of the price certainly paid; hatched = share that may already be paid; mark = declared progress at that point.
Schedule.rangeNote: A range means the order of this payment against a future date or an unreached milestone is not known.
Schedule.officialFeesNote: no official text is cited yet; they are not counted as zero
Schedule.totalComplete: All fees are known and cited.
Schedule.totalLowerBound: Lower bound: unknown fees are not included.
Schedule.installmentInvalid: Each payment needs a share above 0 and up to 100 %, and a date or a progress level.
Schedule.planNot100: The plan does not add up to 100 % of the price. It is shown as entered, not corrected.
Schedule.feeInvalid: A fee without a source is not counted.
Schedule.loanInvalid: The mortgage needs an amount, a rate of 0 % or more and a whole number of years.
Schedule.loanAbovePrice: The amount borrowed is above the price: the mortgage is not simulated.
Schedule.notAdvice: A reading aid, not financial or legal advice. Progress is the one declared in the register, never projected.

ObservedSales.title: Recorded sales
ObservedSales.intro: Sale prices registered with ADREC under this project's name, by type of home: the range and the number of sales, never a single price. They are not asking prices or valuations.
ObservedSales.noWindow: No ADREC sales window has been collected yet for this project's area.
ObservedSales.noSales: No sale under this project's name was registered in this window.
ObservedSales.partialShares: Sales of a partial share (outside the ranges)
ObservedSales.askingPrice: No sourced asking price yet: one will only be shown from a listing with a verified permit, so no gap with these sales is calculated.
ObservedSales.methodText: Sales are those ADREC publishes for the project names linked to this project by a review. Each group gives the smallest and largest recorded value and the number of sales; no average or estimate is calculated.
ObservedSales.limitWindow: ADREC publishes overlapping 90-day windows: only the latest is shown and windows are never added together.
ObservedSales.limitPartial: A sale of a partial share is counted but kept out of the ranges, because its price does not describe a whole home.
ObservedSales.limitNames: Only names identical to the project's are linked; sales recorded under another name are missing.
ObservedSales.limitTypes: Type and layout are given in ADREC's original wording.
ObservedSales.evidenceRegisterName: same name as the project's ADREC register record
